verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a managed immigration and visa service with case tracking. It is not an AI agent or assistant host that would act as an MCP client and consume tools from plugged-in MCP servers, so this client-side axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI agent or any MCP client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
